summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for Bulk Tracker Setup. Added focused pytest suites for isolated CSV/review/router/worker and 1NCE adapter unit behavior, plus live auth/isolation checks and external preview UI flow checks.
action_items: Optional UX hardening: show a deterministic loading state before the 1NCE configured/not-configured banner decision to avoid first-render ambiguity.
If required by ops policy, add a super-admin endpoint to delete test review batches; current API has no delete for tracker_setup_batches.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth middleware prioritizes token tenant_id over crafted X-Tenant-ID, and live tests confirmed tenant data cannot be escaped through header injection.
Bulk router enforces super-admin dependency globally; live tests confirmed victim tenant admin is denied template/list/detail/review/activate/retry.
Worker behavior is conservative and restart-safe in tested paths: does not resend delivered/pending messages, and ambiguous uncertain matches are not auto-resubmitted.
seed_data_creation: Created test review batches in live preview via UI/API review flow (no activate due missing 1NCE config). Isolated provider tests used temporary Mongo DBs dropped in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1NCE env is intentionally blank and validated end-to-end: activation remains disabled in UI and backend returns not-configured state. New regression suites cover CSV validation boundaries, auth gating, X-Tenant-ID isolation behavior, onence adapter payload/path checks, and worker retry/progress semantics in isolated DB.
rca of the issue: No blocking functional bugs reproduced in tested scope. Initial UI check intermittently read notice before polling settled; subsequent runs showed expected '1NCE integration not configured' banner and disabled activation/retry behavior.
